Verified empirically with the patched function: at the new threshold maxY=12, dbstat is SetView(-1, 9, maxX, 11) => content rows 10..10, i.e. ONE content row, which the table header consumes — zero data rows. The comment `dbstatY0 + 1 (header) + 1 (data row) <= maxY - 1` would require maxY >= dbstatY0+4 = 13. This is pre-existing (today at maxY=13 with dbstatY0=10 the same single content row appears) and is NOT introduced by the fix, but the task tells the implementer to rewrite the comment and forbids touching the guard, so the false claim risks being restated as fact — or worse, 'fixed' in the guard, which the task explicitly prohibits.

Do not change the expression. Task 08's stand check only asserts that verbose *turns on* at `-y 12`, so no cross-task conflict — but note the expectation so nobody reports 'empty table at 12 rows' as a Task 01 regression.

findings.issue: Two TDD anchors can pass with the behaviour only partially implemented. `Test_renderPgstatVerbose_boldOnValues` is specified as 'each of the five verbose pgstat rows contains \033[37;1m and \033[0m' — that is satisfied by bolding ONE value per row, while AC #1 requires every numeric value site (the databases row alone has four: size, DatabasesCount, growth, hit; replication has six). `Test_renderSysstatVerbose_boldOnValues` has the same shape. findings.issue: Description says 'The value side gains 12 bytes the sentinel does not.' Measured: `\033[37;1m` is 7 bytes and `\033[0m` is 4 — 11 bytes, not 12. Harmless for the implementation (the fix strips escapes rather than counting them), but the number is wrong and an implementer could use it to hand-adjust an offset instead of stripping.
findings.fix: Say 11 bytes, or better, drop the number entirely — the repair must strip escapes, never offset by a constant.

findings.issue: `Test_clearFilters_noActiveFilters`'s stated detector for 'nothing sent on viewCh' does not work as described. `config.viewCh` is unbuffered (`top/config.go:29`) with no receiver armed in that subcase, so an erroneous unconditional send blocks the handler *inside* `fn(nil, nil)` forever — the test never reaches the non-blocking `select`/`default`, and `make test` hangs until the 10-minute go-test panic instead of failing. The task acknowledges this in Verification Steps ('или повиснет по таймауту') but the anchor is written as if the select is the assertion.
findings.fix: Run the handler in a goroutine and assert with a bounded select: `done := make(chan error, 1); go func(){ done <- fn(nil, nil) }(); select { case err := <-done: assert.NoError(t, err); case v := <-config.viewCh: t.Fatalf("unexpected send on viewCh: %v", v); case <-time.After(time.Second): t.Fatal("handler blocked — it sent on viewCh") }`. `time` is already imported in config_view_test.go. That turns a 10-minute hang into a one-second failure.
